title: 克烈·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 巨大白胡须与军帽刻画小个约德尔人，蜥蜴坐骑保留独立身体。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Kled is a small wiry adult yordle with shaggy pale fur, a huge white moustache, expressive eyebrows, a weathered military cap, and patchwork red-brown clothing. Preserve his fully covered coat, trousers, gloves, boots, and his lizard mount Skaarl with a long beaklike snout. The firearm and polearm stay secured in closed saddle supports, and Skaarl remains a distinct nonhuman companion with all legs readable.
art_direction.scene: A balanced near-frontal full character, subtle contrapposto if anatomically appropriate, silhouette opening into a large quiet paper field. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: pale fur, faded red, lizard teal, golden light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
